snippet.title: Carnival Hammer iPhone game
snippet.description:
A new amazing iPhone game: Carnival Hammer. Test your strength with your iPhone, grab it as if it were a hammer, hit the stake and see how the weight rises.
Take a look at http://games.zed.com/carnival-hammer/.
